_comment: Copy this file to config.json beside it (git ignores config.json) and fill in this computer's folders, with forward slashes. "comfy" is the ComfyUI folder, with the SDXL "checkpoint" in models/checkpoints and the depth "controlnet" (ControlNet Union ProMax) in models/controlnet; "trellis" is the TRELLIS.2 folder, with its own .venv; "blender" is Blender 5 or later, by name if it is on the PATH; "mannequin" is the male mannequin glb in Ikala-Asset-Editor's test_content, with its .blend beside it; "work" is any folder for batches, guides and scratch output; "content" is the character content folder parts are written to, under the "namespace" the editor loads it as. "simplifier", if given, lists the Ikala-Graphics and Ikala-Core jars, built from Ikala-Asset-Editor, whose level of detail simplifier then reduces fitted clothing instead of Blender's decimation (see SimplifyMesh.java), run with "java" (21 or later). "editor", for the capture stage, is a folder that runs the asset editor: Ikala-Core-*.jar with the plugins under plugins/, whose Ikala-Characters config loads "content" under "namespace"; shots are taken there headless, "captureSize" pixels square (1024 if not given), of the character alone unless "captureGui" is true, which keeps the editor's panels in them.
